mapper.sql: SELECT INSIGHT_ID FROM INSIGHT WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT INSIGHT_ID, STORE_ID, BASE_UPLOAD_ID, INSIGHT_TYPE, SALES_FROM, SALES_TO, CANDIDATE_COUNT, COMPARE_BASIS, HEADLINE, SUMMARY, CONCLUSION, CONCLUSION_GOAL_CODE, CONCLUSION_PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT FROM INSIGHT WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, INSIGHT_ID DESC

SELECT ITEM_ID, INSIGHT_ID, ITEM_CATEGORY, SORT_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, EVIDENCE, DECODE(EVIDENCE_SAMPLE_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS EVIDENCE_SAMPLE, GOAL_CODE, PRODUCT_ID FROM INSIGHT_ITEM WHERE INSIGHT_ID IN () ORDER BY INSIGHT_ID, ITEM_CATEGORY, SORT_ORDER
SELECT INSIGHT_ID, DIFF_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, GOOD_VALUE, BAD_VALUE FROM INSIGHT_DIFF WHERE INSIGHT_ID IN () ORDER BY INSIGHT_ID, DIFF_SEQ

SELECT INSIGHT_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, COMPARE_ROLE, SALES_CHANGE_RATE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, LIKE_SUM, COMMENT_SUM, SHARE_SUM, SAVE_SUM, REACH_SUM, REASON FROM INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN WHERE INSIGHT_ID IN () ORDER BY INSIGHT_ID, DECODE(COMPARE_ROLE, 'TARGET', 1, 'GOOD', 2, 3)
SELECT MAX(INSIGHT_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY CREATED_AT) FROM INSIGHT WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_INSIGHT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO INSIGHT (INSIGHT_ID, STORE_ID, BASE_UPLOAD_ID, INSIGHT_TYPE, SALES_FROM, SALES_TO, CANDIDATE_COUNT, COMPARE_BASIS, HEADLINE, SUMMARY, CONCLUSION, CONCLUSION_GOAL_CODE, CONCLUSION_PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{insightId}, #{storeId}, #{baseUploadId}, #{insightType}, #{salesFrom}, #{salesTo}, #{candidateCount}, #{compareBasis}, #{headline}, #{summary}, #{conclusion}, #{conclusionGoalCode}, #{conclusionProductId}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO INSIGHT_ITEM (ITEM_ID, INSIGHT_ID, ITEM_CATEGORY, SORT_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_SAMPLE_YN, GOAL_CODE, PRODUCT_ID) VALUES (SEQ_INSIGHT_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{insightId}, #{itemCategory}, #{sortOrder}, #{title}, #{content}, #{evidence}, ${evidenceSample ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, #{goalCode}, #{productId})
INSERT INTO INSIGHT_DIFF (INSIGHT_ID, DIFF_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, GOOD_VALUE, BAD_VALUE) VALUES (#{insightId}, #{diffSeq}, #{itemName}, #{goodValue}, #{badValue})

INSERT INTO INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN (INSIGHT_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, COMPARE_ROLE, SALES_CHANGE_RATE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, LIKE_SUM, COMMENT_SUM, SHARE_SUM, SAVE_SUM, REACH_SUM, REASON) VALUES (#{insightId}, #{campaignId}, #{compareRole}, #{salesChangeRate}, #{beforeAmount}, #{afterAmount}, #{likeSum}, #{commentSum}, #{shareSum}, #{saveSum}, #{reachSum}, #{reason})
